annotations.title: Review verdicts for TikTok Smart+ ads and creatives

description: TikTok's OWN REVIEW VERDICT for Upgraded Smart+ ads: pass smartPlusAdIds (up to 100, from list_tiktok_smart_campaigns) and each ad comes back approved for every targeted country, approved for only some (with the countries that passed), or rejected, with every rejection reason, TikTok's suggestion, the rejected text / video / image, any appeal status, AND the verdict of each creative inside it (keyed by adMaterialId). Or pass adMaterialIds to review chosen creatives (for one image in a carousel use the adMaterialId this tool returned). lang picks the language of the reasons (default en); includeViolationFrames adds the flagged video frames. An id TikTok says nothing about is named, never read as approved. Classic (non-Smart+) ads: tiktok_ads_review_info. Read-only, free.

adMaterialIds.description: creative ids inside an ad (from a previous review)

advertiserId.description: TikTok advertiser id; omit when the connection has one

includeViolationFrames.description: add the video frames TikTok flagged

lang.description: language of the reasons, e.g. en, es, fr, de, ja (default en)
